## Description

PowerCore engine air filter cross-referenced under OE numbers 178017810 and 17801-7810 for Hino trucks, catalogued in the PowerCore intake subcategory. PowerCore construction adds a compact pleated-media option for space-limited housings, but the source media, size and grade are reference values here Hino truck duty favours high dust capacity and low restriction over long hauls, so our advice is to confirm the exact truck model and housing before committing. Request the spec sheet for dimensions, media and ISO 5011 efficiency/dust-capacity data, and verify the cross-reference against the OE drawing rather than assuming fitment from the number.
